svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Four lengths of 100 x 50 x 5 channel: two 1,000 and two 500 mm long

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outside, ends mitred at 45 degrees, flanges pointing inward.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Weld the corners all round on a flat table; check the diagonals

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: are equal within 2 mm and the top is flat within 1 mm.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Bottom flange: four 14 mm anchor holes, 25 mm in from each end

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: and 30 mm in from the front and back edges.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top flange: eight 11 mm holes for the M10 floor bolts: front, 25 mm

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in, at 100, 350, 650 and 900 from the left end; back, 25 mm in,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: at 520 and 680 from the left end; one each end, centred, 25 mm in.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Grind the welds flush on the top face; paint or galvanize.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the floor pan sits flat on the top flange; the walls stand on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: its edge. Anchors go into the pad at the site, not in the workshop.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: top flat, holes match the floor pan held over it.
